limitations: Assistant estimates, not independent human-expert annotation or clinical ground truth.
Twelve purposively selected frames from familiar development clips; not statistical accuracy or a final holdout.
2D axis agreement does not prove anatomy, body scale, dynamic balance, 3D depth, force, or muscle activation.
Side assignments reflect source-only visual interpretation and are not certified anatomical labels.
protocol: Original decoded frames visually inspected; endpoints and tolerances frozen before inspecting candidate limb predictions. All eight limb segments retained for every frame, with source occlusion explicit. No pose/model outputs used to author labels.
sides: Anatomical left/right: frontal jumps left is image-right, rear squat left is image-left, pushup near side is left. No candidate-based side remapping.
